01

Always one shortcut away

Press Control–Option–Space from anywhere. Stickyy appears, puts the cursor where you need it, and gets out of the way when you’re done.

⌃+⌥+Space

02

Your thoughts stay yours

No account, analytics, advertising, or cloud dependency. Notes live locally inside the macOS App Sandbox.

⌂

03

Clipboard, without the clutter

Optional Clipboard Pills keep five or seven recent snippets, images, and files close. Turn them off whenever you want pure simplicity.

⌘1⌘2⌘3

04

Small notes. Serious reliability.

Automatic local saving, crash recovery, multiple scratchpads, search, pinning, and full keyboard editing are built in—without a save button.
